Asset Hoard v0.1.4 Release Notes

Performance improvements and preview modal

This release brings major performance gains, a unified sorting system, and improvements to 3D model previews.

✨ Features

  • Unified sorting system — New sorting system with tag support and refactored related components
  • Improved 3D preview — Better model centering and camera positioning in the preview modal
  • Linux update notifications — Linux builds now show a "download here" prompt when a new version is released
  • Emissive texture support — Fixed support for emissive textures in material previews

⚡ Performance

  • Thumbnail sharding — Optimized thumbnail storage with automatic migration to a sharded layout
  • Faster bundle stats — Bundle statistics now load in under 0.2s, even for bundles with 500k+ assets

May your assets be organised and your bundles be nested.

Happy hoarding!
